# Card 2 (Unsettled Mariner's cut) — strategist, 2026-11-20 (saved by Jarvis; the agent cannot write files)

Cut: Mask of Memory; runner-up Enduring Curiosity; no rock cut. Caveat: did not read Mask's or Curiosity's oracle text, nor the doctor's argument.
- Mask: a fifth equipment-style piece for a one-body plan, adds nothing when Shabraz is absent, costs no white source, 4/42 voltron pair decks. "Only cut that costs nothing the plan needs."
- Runner-up Enduring Curiosity: draw-on-damage for a deck that already draws. (Jarvis: the strategist's "Shabraz already supplies the draw" is backwards — Shabraz grows ON draws; the rest of the deck is the draw engine.)
- Would NOT cut Fireshrieker (strategy:conversion.availability, loose; recon says the double-strike package is the pilot's own idea; cutting leaves three pieces and orphans 006). Would not touch Gratuitous Violence (007/013/014, Torbran pair).
- White: Mariner is a white two-drop and W is thinnest; cutting Azorius Signet costs W+U fixing on the turn Mariner wants W. A non-white rock costs less.
- Rock at all? strategy:deckbuilding.mana-base: budget sources, not lands; 8 rocks + 37 lands is high, so a rock isn't obviously wrong — but 009's land-light start says early game is the weakness, and Fellwar was the pilot's own 14th-Nov call. Keep every rock.
- NO CHANGE legitimate; Mariner enters on argument alone (no presence in any pair list).
- Expected dissent: doctor says Fireshrieker (least efficient double-strike piece) and that Mask/Curiosity are draw on the deck's axis.
Open: Mask/Curiosity stack or keep entries; /research-strategy topic: redundancy of voltron win pieces (no companion section).

# What Unsettled Mariner taxes — rules-question, 2026-11-20 (saved by Jarvis; the agent cannot write files)

Printed text (MH1): "Whenever you or a permanent you control becomes the target of a spell or ability an opponent controls, counter that spell or ability unless its controller pays {1}."

(a) Swords on Shabraz with no mana left: countered (118.12a "unless" = may pay, if not, do). One spell targeting two of my permanents = two triggers (ruling 2019-06-14; 603.2c), two separate {1} payments (118.10).
(b) NOT taxed: overloaded Cyclonic Rift (no targets, ruling 2024-01-12; 115.1), Blasphemous Act, Toxic Deluge, Fleshbag Marauder ETB, Krenko's ability (115.10a — no "target" word, no target). TAXED: an opponent's equip onto my creature (702.6a targets). Opponent's Aura cast on my creature: expected taxed, not settled by the rules fetched.
(c) Windfall, Rhystic Study, "each opponent"/"each player" effects: never targets (115.10a); "you" in an object's text is not a target (115.10b). "Target player" effects aimed at me ARE taxed (115.1d).

Net for the deck: Mariner is a tax on single-target removal and theft (Swords, Path, Chaos Warp, Rapid Hybridization, steal effects, targeted bounce) and on targeted triggers; it does nothing against wipes, edicts, overloaded Rift, or the A-team's Blasphemous Acts.

Asked: the one cut for Unsettled Mariner, or no change. Answer: Fireshrieker out, Unsettled Mariner in; contested, not forced, and the pilot's keep-four-grants veto would make it NO CHANGE rather than a worse cut. The branch (37 lands, 46 mana sources against a Burgess target of 39, 9 rocks, 11 ramp) is not short of mana pieces, and its finisher axis reads 6 against Zupke's 3-5; what it is short of is bodies before turn three: eight creatures at mana value two or less (Esper Sentinel, Faerie Mastermind, Grand Abolisher, Inti, Kitsa, Lizard Blades, Prince Imrahil, Willie Lumpkin, enumerated from the branch cards.json), and four of the six logged losses opened with no board (003, 004, 005, 009; 009 verbatim: no board until about turn four, took everyone's attacks). So the slot should come from the finisher surplus or the mana surplus, not from interaction (8, exactly the floor), a Human, a draw-seven or a land. Of the five cards that make an 11-power Shabraz lethal (Akroma's Will, Blade Historian, Fireshrieker, Lizard Blades, Gratuitous Violence, enumerated by oracle text), Fireshrieker is the dearest to deploy (three to cast plus two to equip, sorcery speed), the only one that is neither a body, a Human, an instant nor a ping doubler, and the one with no colour: the try screen reads colour sources W +2, U 0, R 0 before and after. Every rock cut touches blue or red, which sit at exactly their Karsten target after the pilot's own two-land pass; Azorius Signet is the best of them (W +2 to +1, U 0 to -1) and is the runner-up. Gratuitous Violence is the other runner-up: the ceiling card by the cutting principle and the right cut if the pilot's priority is the curve, but it orphans three stacks and is the last doubler, so painful.
